6. Safety features: Consider installing safety features, such as anti-tip rails or Load Torque Limiter (LTL), to reduce the risk of under-ride hazards.
7. Operator PPE: Ensure that operators are wearing proper PPE, including a seat belt, when operating a stand-up forklift.
